title: Book Two · Chapter 191: The First Wednesday
story:
On the first Wednesday, Ronan arrives five minutes early. The other two trial students are already outside. Each has a sheet with the same four dates.

Miss Wu opens the door and shows them their work table. Leo and Mei use the small desk near the entrance. The trial table is beside the low shelves.

“You will work here for one hour each Wednesday,” Miss Wu says. “Ask me before you change a public notice. Keep old pages separate from current pages.”

She shows them two trays. One says CURRENT. The other says CHECK WITH TEACHER.

“If you are not sure, use the second tray,” she says. “Write a short question so I can see the problem.”

Ronan looks at the stack on his side. Some pages are clean. Some have marks in the corners. He needs to find the current collection sheet. Then he must sort the copies under it.

He reads every heading first. Then he finds the date. Two sheets look almost the same. One has the old afternoon time. The newer one has a later closing time.

He puts the current sheet at the top. He counts the matching copies. He writes the number on a separate slip. He puts the old copies in the teacher-check tray. He adds a note about their old time.

The girl beside him is checking picture packets. She asks if his old pages can go straight into the waste paper.

“Miss Wu needs to check them first,” he says.

She nods and leaves space for the tray. Ronan leaves the old pages there. He needs Miss Wu's answer before he can throw them away.

Near the end of the hour, Miss Wu checks their work. She finds his current page and reads his old-page note.

“These old copies can be scrap paper now,” she says. “Keep the blank backs.”

Ronan turns the pages over and puts them in the scrap box. Every back is blank. Someone can write there.

He writes his name and the afternoon's work on the trial sheet. Miss Wu adds a short check beside it. The sheet shows the work he has done. These are notes about his trial work. They do not give him a full group place.

Leo is still at the front desk when Ronan leaves. Mei is putting a clear new sign in its holder. Leo and Mei will keep working after Ronan's hour ends.

Outside, Ronan stretches his shoulders. He is tired, but he feels good. He does not need to wait for another selection result tonight. The first work hour is complete.

At home, Mum asks about the first day.

“I saved some old paper,” he says.

“A fine start. We may use the backs here too.”

He shows her the work sheet. Then he puts it away before dinner. His next afternoon is already on the page.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

current＝当前有效的；tray＝托盘；scrap paper＝可再利用的废纸；matching＝相匹配的。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan怎样区分现行材料和需要老师决定的旧材料？
2. 这次表上的记号与原选拔成绩有什么区别？

## 读句子

**He counts the matching copies.**

拆开看：He / counts / the matching copies.

他／清点／相符的复印件。
